name: Bidens

project_scope.admission_note: Both source-pool species approved for learner; native-range UNRESOLVED until target-county audit.

shared_genus_characters.look_here_first: Check middle stem leaves for simple vs compound blades; then count ray florets and outer calyculus bractlets. Confirm with mature cypselae and awn structure.
shared_genus_characters.shared: Asteraceae herbs with opposite leaves and heads of disk florets, sometimes conspicuous rays; cypselae often barbed, giving beggarticks their name.

species_comparison_matrix.lookalike_caution: Compound-leaved B. vulgata; use calyculus and mature cypselae.
B. cernua may share simple leaves, yellow rays and wet habitats; inspect bracts and fruits.

decision_sequence: Photograph a middle stem node with full leaves; count leaflets.
If 3–5 leaflets and rays reduced/absent, test B. frondosa against B. vulgata.
If simple sessile leaves and 7–8 showy rays, test B. laevis against B. cernua.
Photograph outer calyculus bractlets and mature cypselae to confirm; leave at Bidens if fruit/leaf details missing.
diagnostic_photo_checklist: head front and side, ray count and calyculus
matched B. frondosa vs B. laevis comparison
